title: Mean-covariance turnpikes in Wasserstein distributionally robust linear-quadratic control
summary: We study long-horizon Wasserstein-penalized minimax control for discrete-time stochastic linear systems with empirical disturbance data, in which adversarial disturbance distributions induce time-varying mean and covariance dynamics, making standard turnpike arguments not directly applicable. For possibly uncentered data, we characterize the generally nonzero mean reference through a reduced convex-concave Hamiltonian saddle problem.
